evidence.CFG416_declaration: CFG416 FROZEN_CRITERIA: 'not fitted to growth. It comes from the census and group/cluster baryon fractions, stated in advance'
evidence.CFG365_quote: Shull, Smith & Danforth 2012: galaxies, groups and clusters ~10% of baryons; collapsed phases incl. CGM 18+-4%; galaxies only 0.07
evidence.CFG525_D3: 'a declared step taken from the cosmic mean in Shull+12 (recalled, PROVISIONAL)'; KiDS M_b = stars + cold gas matches the galaxies-only 0.07
evidence.CFG634_HC1: calls the 0.10 floor 'stars + cold gas' although the quoted 10% includes group/cluster hot gas (galaxies only = 0.07)
evidence.CFG379_levels: record group/cluster baryon levels use Newtonian hydrostatic M500 (X-COP M_FORW, Lovisari+15) relative to Planck f_b

G galaxy floor 0.10 (log M_ta < 12.5 Msu.lcdm_mass_function: not verifiable (the ICM share of the 10% is Shull's; method not in repo)
G galaxy floor 0.10 (log M_ta < 12.5 Msu.mass_coordinate: framework fixed point M_ta = M_b h/(f_ret f_b) (no measured halo mass enters); CFG804 drops the h (Msun, 0.171 dex)
G galaxy floor 0.10 (log M_ta < 12.5 Msu.note: cosmic-mean census fraction applied per catchment (assumption: every baryon belongs to some catchment; a per-galaxy value is not measured); recalled, PROVISIONAL (CFG525); the quoted 0.10 includes group/cluster hot gas, the galaxies-only value is 0.07

C group/cluster ramp (0.10 -> 0.55 @13.5.hydrostatic_as_DM: likely (the record's group/cluster fractions are M_b/M500,HSE over Planck f_b) but not documented
C group/cluster ramp (0.10 -> 0.55 @13.5.mass_coordinate: hand-set in M_ta; the R500 -> turnaround-catchment mapping (r_ta ~ 5-13 R200, CFG656) is not documented anywhere in the record
C group/cluster ramp (0.10 -> 0.55 @13.5.note: no source table, no script and no derivation in the repo (declared in CFG416); CFG830 counts these as hand-set census numbers
